attacks.name: Cat Claws
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
After this attack is resolved, if it dealt |!damage|, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.
|!wild| |*Pierce|: Change 1 of the defending character's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!block| results to a Blank.

attacks.name: Troublemaker
steps: If this attack would deal 1 or more |!damage|, it deals 1 |!damage| instead.
After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition.
|!wild| |*Elusive|: After this attack is resolved, this character may Advance |!range_small|.

superPowers.name: Grappling Hook
superPowers.body: Place this character within |!range| 2 of its current position. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Master Cat Burglar
superPowers.body: |*Action|: Choose an enemy character within |!range| 1 of this character. Move 1 Asset or Civilian token the chosen character is holding to this character. This character is now holding that token. This character may not hold more tokens than the Crisis specifies.

superPowers.name: Bad Luck
superPowers.body: When targeting this character with attacks, enemy characters cannot modify their attack dice and they do not roll additional dice for |!critical| results in their attack rolls.

superPowers.name: Stealth
superPowers.body: Characters must be within |!range| 3 of this character to target it with attacks.

erratas.body: "Cat Claws" was added a special rule that can inflict Bleed.
"Master Cat Burglar" was renamed into "Master Cat Burgler" and now costs an action.
"Bad Luck" now prevent enemy characters from rolling additional dice for |!critical| results in their attack rolls.
